title: macOS CI skips all 13 of menuz's macos.bats tests, because the runner has no bash 5 on PATH for devbin
body:
## What

On CI's "Test on macOS", all 13 tests in `opt/menuz/test/macos.bats` skip, with "devbin needs bash 5 and none is on PATH". So macOS CI never tests what Utilz keeps of devbin's macos verb: the macos: declaration in `bin/.devbin/config.yaml`, the bundle id's second copy there, and app-icons with its check (AC-06.3). The job stays green, because a skip passes.

devbin refuses bash 3.2 by name, and `setup_file` takes its bash 5 from `type -ap bash` alone. The macOS job installs no bash, so the only bash on the runner's PATH is `/bin/bash` 3.2.

Adding `bash` to the job's `brew install` would not do. It links `/opt/homebrew/bin/bash`, which comes before `/bin` on the runner's PATH, and `bin/utilz`, `opt/utilz/test/test_helper.bash` and `bin/devbin` start with `#!/usr/bin/env bash`. Every macOS suite would move from bash 3.2 to bash 5, and macOS CI is the leg that runs them under 3.2.

## Measured

Read 30 Oct 2026, from GitHub's logs of CI's "Utilz Tests" and from the tree at d7af740f:

- 2.14.8's tag run 41127538028 at f2021ddc: "Test on macOS" (image macos-26-arm64) is green. Its log has `ok 1` to `ok 13` of macos.bats each ending `# skip devbin needs bash 5 and none is on PATH`. Test 7, "the real rsvg-convert makes PNGs of the sizes asked for", is among them.
- Dispatch 41120955230 at 878994e8 has the same 13 skips. Its "Install dependencies" step prints the runner's PATH: `/opt/homebrew/bin` is the 4th entry, and `/usr/bin` and `/bin` are the 16th and 17th. Every step runs as `shell: /bin/bash -e {0}`.
- utilz-vc read the same 13 skips at 2.14.7's tag run 40935690642.
- `.github/workflows/tests.yml:134` is `brew install yq fileicon coreutils unison qpdf poppler lua`, with no bash.
- `bin/utilz`, `opt/utilz/test/test_helper.bash` and `bin/devbin` each start with `#!/usr/bin/env bash`.
- macos.bats' header (lines 17-20) says the tests run "under the first bash 5 on PATH", and `setup_file` (lines 24-30) reads only `type -ap bash`.
- No variable in the tree names a bash for the tests (`git grep`). The `UTILZ_TEST_*` names in use are PLATFORM, PLATFORM_BIN, TMPDIR, DEBUG and DIR, so this issue adds `UTILZ_TEST_BASH5`.
- Homebrew's `Keg#unlink` removes a keg's links under the prefix and its linked-keg record. It leaves the keg's opt link, which only `Keg#uninstall` removes. `brew --prefix <formula>` prints the formula's opt prefix. This was read in `Library/Homebrew/keg.rb` and `cmd/--prefix.rb` of Homebrew 7.0.11 on rhadamanth; the runner's version may differ. So after `brew unlink bash`, `$(brew --prefix bash)/bin/bash` still reaches the keg's bash 5, and `/opt/homebrew/bin/bash` is gone.

## Design

Size: XS. This is option (b) of utilz-vc's hold 24 (6). hv picked it on 30 Oct, first-hand in utilz-vc's session: "Ok, go with your rec. Although (b) seems more complex than (c) from what I can understand there."

- tests.yml's macOS "Install dependencies" step runs `brew install bash` and then `brew unlink bash`, so `/usr/bin/env bash` still finds `/bin/bash` 3.2. It then writes `UTILZ_TEST_BASH5=$(brew --prefix bash)/bin/bash` to `$GITHUB_ENV`. Two comment lines say why and name this issue.
- In macos.bats' `setup_file`, the loop tries `UTILZ_TEST_BASH5` before `type -ap bash`, and the first bash 5 still wins. When the variable is unset, it gives one empty candidate, which fails the version check as bash 3.2 does. The header says so.
- The macOS "Run diagnostics" step prints the bash that `bash` resolves to and its version.
- Where `UTILZ_TEST_BASH5` is unset, nothing changes: the Linux job and developer machines take the first bash 5 on PATH, as now.
- The change is CI and test only, so it gets no CHANGELOG line and no menuz VERSION bump, as with 0129.
- The diff is +10 -2 in two files: tests.yml +6, macos.bats +4 -2.

## Proof

By reading:

- After the unlink, the only bash on the runner's PATH is `/bin/bash`, so every later step's shell and every `#!/usr/bin/env bash` stays on 3.2, as now.
- `setup_file` tries the keg's bash first. It passes `(( BASH_VERSINFO[0] >= 5 ))`, so `BASH5` is set and `setup` no longer skips, and devbin runs under it through the fakes' `bash` link.

The proof in CI is hv's push and then a manual run, because "Test on macOS" runs only on a tag or a dispatch:

- "Run diagnostics" prints `bash on PATH: /bin/bash` with a 3.2 version.
- "Test on macOS" runs macos.bats' 13 tests. Test 7 still skips, with "rsvg-convert is not installed here", as designed where the runner has no rsvg-convert, and the job's brew list installs none.
- "Test on Ubuntu" is unchanged, since it sets no `UTILZ_TEST_BASH5`.
